question: According to Census of India 2011, the lowest literacy rate was recorded in the Union Territory of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** recorded the lowest literacy rate among the Union Territories.
 
• The literacy rate of Dadra and Nagar Haveli in 2011 was **76.24%**.
 
• Despite being a Union Territory, **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** had a significantly lower literacy rate compared to other Union Territories.
 
• Efforts have been made to improve education and literacy rates in Dadra and Nagar Haveli in recent years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate in India**

 
 
• The national literacy rate of India as per Census 2011 was 74.04%.
 
• Kerala recorded the highest literacy rate at 93.91% in the 2011 Census.
 
• The literacy rate is calculated as the percentage of literate persons aged seven and above.
 
• India has made significant progress in improving literacy rates since independence.
 
 
 
• **Factors Affecting Literacy Rates**
 
 
• Socio-economic conditions, such as poverty and lack of infrastructure, can affect literacy rates.
 
 
• **Government Initiatives**
 
 
• The Indian government has launched various programs like Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan to improve literacy.
 
• Mid-Day Meal Scheme helps increase school attendance and improve nutrition among children.
 
• Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao aims to promote education among girls and reduce gender disparities.
 
• Adult Education Programs target illiterate adults to enhance their literacy skills.
